response.sql:
WITH grouped_rates AS (
  SELECT
    si.riskeval,
    SUM(sc.gbsize) / SUM(sc.spanmin) AS rate
  FROM scans sc
  INNER JOIN sites si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY si.riskeval
),
benchmark_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS benchmark_rate FROM grouped_rates
)
SELECT
  AVG(CASE WHEN gr.rate > bc.benchmark_rate THEN gr.rate ELSE NULL END) AS avg_rate,
  AVG(CASE WHEN gr.rate > bc.benchmark_rate THEN gr.rate - bc.benchmark_rate ELSE NULL END) AS avg_excess
FROM grouped_rates gr
CROSS JOIN benchmark_calc bc;

assumptions.assumption: The join key 'site code' refers to scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry.
NULLs in sites.riskeval form a single group (standard SQL GROUP BY treatment), which is the 'group of their own' for scans whose site has no recorded risk evaluation status.
